rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The helper floors line 11 at zero where the corrected instruction ('Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11a, minus lines 12e and 13b', i8995-correction) states no floor. A negative and a zero line 11 give the same line 12 comparison and the same line 13 ('if zero or less, enter -0-'), so the deduction is unchanged; a printed line 11 would read 0 where the form would show a negative amount. No change to the data.

rulings.restated: Enter the amount from qbi helper "Add sd.net_gain, f1040.line3a".
rulings.model: The instructions say 'If you're not required to file Schedule D (Form 1040), your net capital gain is the amount reported on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 7a.' The restatement always uses the smaller of Schedule D lines 15 and 16 and never uses line 7a.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. For a Schedule D filer the helper is the smaller of Schedule D lines 15 and 16, floored at zero, plus Form 1040 line 3a, as i8995 p. 4, Line 12 says. When Schedule D is not required ('your net capital gain is the amount reported on Form 1040 ... line 7a') the only capital item in scope is capital gain distributions, and the Schedule D lines are still figured from line 13 alone, so lines 15 and 16 both equal the line 7a amount (checked earlier: $1,234 of distributions gives sd.line15 = sd.line16 = f1040.line7a = qbi.net_capital_gain = $1,234). No change to the data.

rulings.restated: Add person.qbi over every confirmed person entry, within the current person when parent-bound. An unanswered roster is unknown.
rulings.model: The IRS line says 'Combine lines 1i through 1v, column (c)', which is a total over trades, businesses, or aggregations. The restatement sums person.qbi over person entries, and person.qbi is not defined in the glossary, so it cannot be confirmed that this equals the per-business column (c) total.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; restatement accepted. person.qbi is the sum over the person's Schedule C entries of sc.qbi, which is Form 8995 line 1 column (c) for that business (sc.yaml, printed 1(c), cited to i8995 p. 4, Line 1, column (c)); line 2 adds them over the persons on the return, which is lines 1i to 1v column (c) with one row per Schedule C, and more than five businesses are included in the line 2 total as i8995 says ('include the income and loss from those trade(s) or business(es) in the total for line 2'). Other trades or businesses are refused through qbi.unsupported.
